public_rpc.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_card_printing_options_v1(p_card_print_ids uuid[], p_limit integer DEFAULT 1000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, card_print_id uuid, printing_gv_id text, finish_key text, finish_label text, finish_sort_order integer, finish_is_active boolean, image_source text, image_path text, image_url text, image_alt_url text, image_status text, image_note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_card_print_ids uuid[];
begin
  v_card_print_ids := array(
    select distinct requested_id
    from unnest(coalesce(p_card_print_ids, array[]::uuid[])) as requested(requested_id)
    where requested_id is not null
    order by requested_id
  );

  if cardinality(v_card_print_ids) > 250 then
    raise exception 'At most 250 card print ids may be requested.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 1000 then
    raise exception 'p_limit must be between 1 and 1000.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then
    raise exception 'p_offset must be zero or greater.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    cp.id, cp.card_print_id, cp.printing_gv_id, cp.finish_key,
    fk.label as finish_label, fk.sort_order as finish_sort_order,
    fk.is_active as finish_is_active,
    cp.image_source, cp.image_path, cp.image_url, cp.image_alt_url,
    cp.image_status, cp.image_note
  from public.card_printings cp
  join public.finish_keys fk on fk.key = cp.finish_key
  where cp.card_print_id = any(v_card_print_ids)
    and public.catalog_card_print_visible_to_request_v1(cp.card_print_id)
    and fk.is_active = true
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.card_printing_truth_reviews review
      where review.card_printing_id = cp.id
        and review.active = true
        and review.public_visibility in ('hidden_pending_review', 'hidden_unsupported')
    )
  order by cp.card_print_id, fk.sort_order, fk.label, cp.id
  limit p_limit
  offset p_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_market_pricing_read_model_v1(p_card_print_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], p_card_printing_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(pricing_scope text, card_print_id uuid, card_printing_id uuid, gv_id text, printing_gv_id text, finish_key text, status text, unavailable_reason text, currency text, market_close numeric, source_name text, source_label text, observed_at timestamp with time zone, published_at timestamp with time zone, freshness text, low_price numeric, mid_price numeric, high_price numeric, direct_low_price numeric, is_from_price boolean, eligible_printing_count integer, lowest_active_ask numeric, active_ask_listing_count integer, active_ask_observed_at timestamp with time zone, provenance_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with recursive requested_parents as materialized (
    select distinct requested.card_print_id
    from unnest(coalesce(p_card_print_ids, '{}'::uuid[]))
      as requested(card_print_id)
  ),
  requested_printings as materialized (
    select distinct requested.card_printing_id
    from unnest(coalesce(p_card_printing_ids, '{}'::uuid[]))
      as requested(card_printing_id)
  ),
  current_context(publication_set_id,run_id,previous_publication_set_id,visited) as (
    select publication.id,publication.run_id,publication.previous_publication_set_id,array[publication.id]
    from public.market_price_current_publication pointer
    join public.market_price_publication_sets publication on publication.id=pointer.publication_set_id
      and publication.run_id=pointer.run_id and publication.publication_state='published'
    join public.market_price_pipeline_runs run on run.id=publication.run_id
      and run.reconciliation_state='reconciled' and run.state in ('published','verified')
      and run.run_mode in ('production','canary')
    where pointer.singleton
    union all
    select publication.id,publication.run_id,publication.previous_publication_set_id,
      accepted.visited||publication.id
    from current_context accepted
    join public.market_price_publication_sets publication on publication.id=accepted.previous_publication_set_id
      and publication.publication_state='superseded' and publication.published_at is not null
    join public.market_price_pipeline_runs run on run.id=publication.run_id
      and run.reconciliation_state='reconciled' and run.state in ('published','verified')
      and run.run_mode in ('production','canary')
    where not publication.id=any(accepted.visited)
  ),
  requested_parent_prices as materialized (
    select distinct on (snapshot.card_printing_id)
      snapshot.card_print_id,
      snapshot.card_printing_id,
      snapshot.gv_id,
      snapshot.printing_gv_id,
      snapshot.finish_key,
      snapshot.currency,
      snapshot.market_price,
      snapshot.low_price,
      snapshot.mid_price,
      snapshot.high_price,
      snapshot.direct_low_price,
      snapshot.source_sync_finished_at as observed_at,
      snapshot.published_at,
      case when snapshot.source_sync_finished_at >= now()-interval '36 hours'
        then 'fresh'::text else 'stale'::text end as freshness,
      snapshot.provenance_id
    from requested_parents requested
    join current_context current_state on true
    join public.market_price_publication_snapshots snapshot
      on snapshot.publication_set_id = current_state.publication_set_id
     and snapshot.run_id = current_state.run_id
     and snapshot.card_print_id = requested.card_print_id
    join public.market_price_qualification_decisions decision
      on decision.id = snapshot.qualification_decision_id
     and decision.run_id = snapshot.run_id
     and decision.eligible = true
     and decision.decision = 'publish'
     and decision.publication_lane = 'current'
    where not exists (
      select 1 from public.external_mappings rejected_mapping
      where rejected_mapping.id = snapshot.source_mapping_id
        and rejected_mapping.meta->'reviewed_invalidation'->>'reason_code'
          = 'PROVEN_UNSTAMPED_PRODUCT_ON_STAMPED_PARENT'
    ) and snapshot.publication_state = 'published'
      and snapshot.freshness_state = 'fresh'
      and (not exists(select 1 from public.jungle_edition_identity_links_v1 link
        where link.state in ('active','retired')
          and snapshot.card_print_id in (link.legacy_card_print_id,link.card_print_id))
        or snapshot.edition_assignment_id is not null or snapshot.gym_edition_assignment_id is not null)
      and snapshot.source_sync_finished_at <= now()+interval '6 minutes'
      and public.market_retained_price_identity_valid_v1(to_jsonb(snapshot))
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.card_printing_truth_reviews truth_review
        where truth_review.card_printing_id = snapshot.card_printing_id
          and truth_review.active = true
          and truth_review.public_visibility in (
            'hidden_pending_review',
            'hidden_unsupported'
          )
      )
    order by
      snapshot.card_printing_id,
      snapshot.source_sync_finished_at desc,
      snapshot.published_at desc,
      snapshot.id desc
  ),
  requested_printing_prices as materialized (
    select distinct on (snapshot.card_printing_id)
      snapshot.card_print_id,
      snapshot.card_printing_id,
      snapshot.gv_id,
      snapshot.printing_gv_id,
      snapshot.finish_key,
      snapshot.currency,
      snapshot.market_price,
      snapshot.low_price,
      snapshot.mid_price,
      snapshot.high_price,
      snapshot.direct_low_price,
      snapshot.source_sync_finished_at as observed_at,
      snapshot.published_at,
      case when snapshot.source_sync_finished_at >= now()-interval '36 hours'
        then 'fresh'::text else 'stale'::text end as freshness,
      snapshot.provenance_id
    from requested_printings requested
    join current_context current_state on true
    join public.market_price_publication_snapshots snapshot
      on snapshot.publication_set_id = current_state.publication_set_id
     and snapshot.run_id = current_state.run_id
     and snapshot.card_printing_id = requested.card_printing_id
    join public.market_price_qualification_decisions decision
      on decision.id = snapshot.qualification_decision_id
     and decision.run_id = snapshot.run_id
     and decision.eligible = true
     and decision.decision = 'publish'
     and decision.publication_lane = 'current'
    where not exists (
      select 1 from public.external_mappings rejected_mapping
      where rejected_mapping.id = snapshot.source_mapping_id
        and rejected_mapping.meta->'reviewed_invalidation'->>'reason_code'
          = 'PROVEN_UNSTAMPED_PRODUCT_ON_STAMPED_PARENT'
    ) and snapshot.publication_state = 'published'
      and snapshot.freshness_state = 'fresh'
      and (not exists(select 1 from public.jungle_edition_identity_links_v1 link
        where link.state in ('active','retired')
          and snapshot.card_print_id in (link.legacy_card_print_id,link.card_print_id))
        or snapshot.edition_assignment_id is not null or snapshot.gym_edition_assignment_id is not null)
      and snapshot.source_sync_finished_at <= now()+interval '6 minutes'
      and public.market_retained_price_identity_valid_v1(to_jsonb(snapshot))
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.card_printing_truth_reviews truth_review
        where truth_review.card_printing_id = snapshot.card_printing_id
          and truth_review.active = true
          and truth_review.public_visibility in (
            'hidden_pending_review',
            'hidden_unsupported'
          )
      )
    order by
      snapshot.card_printing_id,
      snapshot.source_sync_finished_at desc,
      snapshot.published_at desc,
      snapshot.id desc
  ),
  ranked_parent_prices as materialized (
    select
      current_price.*,
      count(*) over (
        partition by current_price.card_print_id
      )::integer as eligible_printing_count,
      row_number() over (
        partition by current_price.card_print_id
        order by
          current_price.market_price asc,
          current_price.published_at desc,
          current_price.observed_at desc,
          current_price.card_printing_id asc
      ) as parent_price_rank
    from requested_parent_prices current_price
  ),
  parent_active_asks as materialized (
    select
      current_price.card_print_id,
      min(active_ask.lowest_active_ask)::numeric as lowest_active_ask,
      sum(coalesce(active_ask.listing_count, 0))::integer
        as active_ask_listing_count,
      max(active_ask.observed_at) as active_ask_observed_at
    from requested_parent_prices current_price
    left join public.mv_market_listing_active_ask_current_v1 active_ask
      on active_ask.card_printing_id = current_price.card_printing_id
    group by current_price.card_print_id
  ),
  parent_summaries as materialized (
    select
      selected.card_print_id,
      selected.card_printing_id,
      selected.gv_id,
      selected.printing_gv_id,
      selected.finish_key,
      selected.currency,
      selected.market_price::numeric as market_close,
      selected.eligible_printing_count,
      (selected.eligible_printing_count > 1) as is_from_price,
      selected.observed_at,
      selected.published_at,
      selected.freshness,
      selected.provenance_id,
      active_ask.lowest_active_ask,
      active_ask.active_ask_listing_count,
      active_ask.active_ask_observed_at
    from ranked_parent_prices selected
    left join parent_active_asks active_ask
      on active_ask.card_print_id = selected.card_print_id
    where selected.parent_price_rank = 1
  ),
  latest_parent_decisions as materialized (
    select
      requested.card_print_id,
      latest.reason_codes,
      latest.freshness_result,
      latest.publication_lane
    from requested_parents requested
    left join lateral (
      select
        decision.reason_codes,
        decision.freshness_result,
        decision.publication_lane
      from public.market_price_qualification_decisions decision
      join public.market_price_pipeline_runs pipeline_run
        on pipeline_run.id = decision.run_id
       and pipeline_run.run_mode in ('canary', 'production')
       and pipeline_run.state not in ('failed', 'rolled_back')
      where decision.card_print_id = requested.card_print_id
      order by decision.evaluated_at desc, decision.id desc
      limit 1
    ) latest on true
  ),
  latest_printing_decisions as materialized (
    select
      requested.card_printing_id,
      latest.reason_codes,
      latest.freshness_result,
      latest.publication_lane
    from requested_printings requested
    left join lateral (
      select
        decision.reason_codes,
        decision.freshness_result,
        decision.publication_lane
      from public.market_price_qualification_decisions decision
      join public.market_price_pipeline_runs pipeline_run
        on pipeline_run.id = decision.run_id
       and pipeline_run.run_mode in ('canary', 'production')
       and pipeline_run.state not in ('failed', 'rolled_back')
      where decision.card_printing_id = requested.card_printing_id
      order by decision.evaluated_at desc, decision.id desc
      limit 1
    ) latest on true
  )
  select
    'parent'::text,
    requested.card_print_id,
    parent.card_printing_id,
    card.gv_id,
    parent.printing_gv_id,
    parent.finish_key,
    case when parent.card_print_id is null then 'unavailable' else 'available' end,
    case
      when parent.card_print_id is not null then null::text
      when latest.freshness_result = 'delayed'
        then 'source_freshness_delayed'
      when latest.freshness_result = 'suppressed_stale'
        then 'suppressed_stale'
      when cardinality(latest.reason_codes) > 0 then latest.reason_codes[1]
      else 'no_current_qualified_market_price'
    end,
    parent.currency,
    parent.market_close,
    'tcgplayer'::text,
    case
      when parent.is_from_price then 'From TCGPlayer Market'
      else 'TCGPlayer Market'
    end,
    parent.observed_at,
    parent.published_at,
    coalesce(parent.freshness, latest.freshness_result, 'unavailable'),
    null::numeric,
    null::numeric,
    null::numeric,
    null::numeric,
    coalesce(parent.is_from_price, false),
    coalesce(parent.eligible_printing_count, 0),
    parent.lowest_active_ask,
    parent.active_ask_listing_count,
    parent.active_ask_observed_at,
    parent.provenance_id
  from requested_parents requested
  left join public.card_prints card
    on card.id = requested.card_print_id
  left join parent_summaries parent
    on parent.card_print_id = requested.card_print_id
  left join latest_parent_decisions latest
    on latest.card_print_id = requested.card_print_id

  union all

  select
    'card_printing'::text,
    printing.card_print_id,
    requested.card_printing_id,
    card.gv_id,
    printing.printing_gv_id,
    printing.finish_key,
    case when exact.card_printing_id is null then 'unavailable' else 'available' end,
    case
      when exact.card_printing_id is not null then null::text
      when latest.freshness_result = 'delayed'
        then 'source_freshness_delayed'
      when latest.freshness_result = 'suppressed_stale'
        then 'suppressed_stale'
      when cardinality(latest.reason_codes) > 0 then latest.reason_codes[1]
      else 'no_current_qualified_market_price'
    end,
    exact.currency,
    exact.market_price,
    'tcgplayer'::text,
    'TCGPlayer Market'::text,
    exact.observed_at,
    exact.published_at,
    coalesce(exact.freshness, latest.freshness_result, 'unavailable'),
    exact.low_price,
    exact.mid_price,
    exact.high_price,
    exact.direct_low_price,
    false,
    case when exact.card_printing_id is null then 0 else 1 end,
    active_ask.lowest_active_ask,
    active_ask.listing_count,
    active_ask.observed_at,
    exact.provenance_id
  from requested_printings requested
  left join public.card_printings printing
    on printing.id = requested.card_printing_id
  left join public.card_prints card
    on card.id = printing.card_print_id
  left join requested_printing_prices exact
    on exact.card_printing_id = requested.card_printing_id
  left join public.mv_market_listing_active_ask_current_v1 active_ask
    on active_ask.card_printing_id = requested.card_printing_id
  left join latest_printing_decisions latest
    on latest.card_printing_id = requested.card_printing_id
  order by 1, 2, 6 nulls first;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.market_retained_jungle_price_row_valid_v1(row_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare frozen jsonb; expected record; field_name text;
begin
  if row_data->>'edition_assignment_id' is null
     or row_data->>'gym_edition_assignment_id' is not null then return false; end if;
  select assignment.assignment_payload into frozen
  from public.tcgplayer_jungle_edition_assignments_v1 assignment
  where assignment.id=(row_data->>'edition_assignment_id')::uuid
    and exists(select 1 from public.resolve_tcgplayer_jungle_edition_v1(
      (row_data->>'source_product_id')::integer,row_data->>'source_subtype_name',
      assignment.assignment_payload#>>'{source,product_hash}') resolved
      where resolved.binding_id=assignment.binding_id
        and resolved.card_print_id=(row_data->>'card_print_id')::uuid
        and resolved.card_printing_id=(row_data->>'card_printing_id')::uuid
        and resolved.finish_key=row_data->>'finish_key');
  if not found then return false; end if;
  if row_data->>'source_mapping_id' is not null
     or row_data->>'variant_assignment_id' is not null then return false; end if;
  if row_data ? 'edition_assignment_payload'
     and row_data->'edition_assignment_payload' is distinct from frozen then return false; end if;
  for expected in select * from jsonb_each_text(jsonb_build_object(
    'variant_assignment_version','TCGPLAYER_JUNGLE_EDITION_ASSIGNMENT_V1',
    'variant_assignment_status','exact_child_finish','mapping_method','jungle_edition_binding_v1',
    'language_result','english','finish_result','exact_child_finish','source_integrity_result','passed',
    'duplicate_product_result','unique','freshness_result','fresh'
  )) loop
    if row_data ? expected.key and row_data->>expected.key is distinct from expected.value
      then return false; end if;
  end loop;
  for expected in select * from jsonb_each_text(jsonb_build_object(
    'source_observation_id',frozen#>'{source,observation_id}',
    'source_sync_run_id',frozen#>'{source,sync_run_id}',
    'source_artifact_id',frozen#>'{source,artifact_id}',
    'source_artifact_hash',frozen#>'{source,artifact_hash}',
    'source_product_id',frozen#>'{source,product_id}',
    'source_subtype_name',frozen#>'{source,subtype}',
    'source_row_hash',frozen#>'{source,row_hash}',
    'source_price_row_identity',frozen#>'{source,price_row_identity}',
    'currency',frozen#>'{source,currency}',
    'card_print_id',frozen#>'{canonical,card_print_id}',
    'card_printing_id',frozen#>'{canonical,card_printing_id}',
    'gv_id',frozen#>'{canonical,gv_id}',
    'printing_gv_id',frozen#>'{canonical,printing_gv_id}',
    'finish_key',frozen#>'{canonical,finish_key}'
  )) loop
    if row_data->>expected.key is distinct from expected.value then return false; end if;
  end loop;
  if (row_data->>'source_artifact_date')::date
       is distinct from (frozen#>>'{source,artifact_observed_on}')::date
    or (row_data->>'source_observed_on')::date
       is distinct from (frozen#>>'{source,observed_on}')::date
    or (row_data->>'market_price')::numeric
       is distinct from (frozen#>>'{source,market_price}')::numeric
    or extract(epoch from (row_data->>'source_sync_finished_at')::timestamptz)
       is distinct from (frozen#>>'{source,sync_finished_at_epoch}')::numeric
    then return false; end if;
  foreach field_name in array array['low_price','mid_price','high_price','direct_low_price'] loop
    if row_data ? field_name and (row_data->>field_name)::numeric
      is distinct from (frozen->'source'->>field_name)::numeric then return false; end if;
  end loop;
  return true;
exception when invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or numeric_value_out_of_range then
  return false;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.market_retained_price_identity_valid_v1(row_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare valid_target boolean;
begin
  select exists(select 1 from public.card_printings printing
    join public.card_prints card on card.id=printing.card_print_id
    where printing.id=(row_data->>'card_printing_id')::uuid
      and card.id=(row_data->>'card_print_id')::uuid
      and card.gv_id=row_data->>'gv_id'
      and printing.printing_gv_id=row_data->>'printing_gv_id'
      and printing.finish_key=row_data->>'finish_key'
      and not exists(select 1 from public.card_printing_truth_reviews review
        where review.card_printing_id=printing.id and review.active
          and review.public_visibility in ('hidden_pending_review','hidden_unsupported')))
  into valid_target;
  if not valid_target then return false; end if;
  if row_data->>'gym_edition_assignment_id' is not null then
    return public.market_retained_gym_price_row_valid_v1(row_data);
  elsif row_data->>'edition_assignment_id' is not null then
    return public.market_retained_jungle_price_row_valid_v1(row_data);
  elsif row_data->>'source_mapping_id' is not null or row_data->>'cross_tcg_source_mapping_id' is not null then
    return exists(select 1 from public.external_mappings mapping
      where mapping.id=coalesce(row_data->>'source_mapping_id',row_data->>'cross_tcg_source_mapping_id')::bigint
        and mapping.active and mapping.source='tcgplayer'
        and mapping.external_id=row_data->>'source_product_id'
        and mapping.card_print_id=(row_data->>'card_print_id')::uuid
        and mapping.meta->'reviewed_invalidation'->>'reason_code' is distinct from 'PROVEN_UNSTAMPED_PRODUCT_ON_STAMPED_PARENT');
  elsif row_data->>'mtg_printing_mapping_id' is not null or row_data->>'cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id' is not null then
    return exists(select 1 from public.external_printing_mappings mapping
      where mapping.id=coalesce(row_data->>'mtg_printing_mapping_id',row_data->>'cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id')::uuid
        and mapping.active and mapping.source in ('tcgplayer','tcgplayer_market')
        and mapping.card_printing_id=(row_data->>'card_printing_id')::uuid
        and mapping.external_id in (row_data->>'source_product_id',
          (row_data->>'source_product_id')||':'||(row_data->>'finish_key')));
  end if;
  return false;
exception when invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or numeric_value_out_of_range then
  return false;
end;
$function$

WITH source_run AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.id,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.run_key,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.sync_mode,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.status,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.source_marker,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.observed_on,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.date_from,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.date_to,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.request_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.category_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.group_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.product_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.price_row_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.inserted_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.updated_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.no_op_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.failed_count,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.artifact_root,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.artifact_hash,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.worker_version,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.parser_version,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.schema_contract_version,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.git_commit_sha,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.started_at,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.finished_at,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.error,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.payload,
            tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.created_at
           FROM tcgcsv_source_sync_runs
          WHERE tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.sync_mode = 'current_full_sync'::text AND tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.status = 'completed'::text AND tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.failed_count = 0 AND tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.finished_at IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.finished_at DESC, tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.created_at DESC, tcgcsv_source_sync_runs.id DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), observations AS (
         SELECT observation_1.id,
            observation_1.source_price_row_identity,
            observation_1.product_id,
            observation_1.category_id,
            observation_1.group_id,
            observation_1.subtype_name,
            observation_1.subtype_name_normalized,
            observation_1.observed_on,
            observation_1.low_price,
            observation_1.mid_price,
            observation_1.high_price,
            observation_1.market_price,
            observation_1.direct_low_price,
            observation_1.currency,
            observation_1.raw_payload,
            observation_1.payload_hash,
            observation_1.source_archive_path,
            observation_1.source_artifact_id,
            observation_1.first_observed_at,
            observation_1.last_observed_at,
            observation_1.first_seen_run_id,
            observation_1.last_seen_run_id,
            observation_1.created_at,
            observation_1.updated_at,
            source_run.sync_mode,
            source_run.status AS source_sync_status,
            source_run.finished_at AS source_sync_finished_at,
            source_run.failed_count AS source_sync_failed_count,
            source_run.artifact_hash AS source_run_artifact_hash,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY observation_1.product_id, observation_1.subtype_name_normalized)::integer AS duplicate_product_row_count
           FROM tcgcsv_source_price_daily_observations observation_1
             JOIN source_run ON source_run.id = observation_1.last_seen_run_id AND source_run.observed_on = observation_1.observed_on
          WHERE observation_1.category_id = ANY (ARRAY[68, 85])
        )
 SELECT observation.id AS source_observation_id,
    observation.last_seen_run_id AS source_sync_run_id,
    observation.source_artifact_id,
    artifact.observed_on AS source_artifact_date,
    artifact.sha256 AS source_artifact_hash,
    artifact.byte_size AS source_artifact_byte_size,
    artifact.http_status AS source_artifact_http_status,
    observation.source_price_row_identity,
    observation.payload_hash AS source_row_hash,
    observation.product_id AS source_product_id,
    observation.category_id,
    observation.group_id,
    observation.subtype_name AS source_subtype_name,
    observation.subtype_name_normalized,
    observation.observed_on AS source_observed_on,
    observation.last_observed_at AS source_last_observed_at,
    observation.duplicate_product_row_count,
    observation.currency,
    observation.low_price,
    observation.mid_price,
    observation.high_price,
    observation.market_price,
    observation.direct_low_price,
    product.name AS source_product_name,
    product.source_active AS source_product_active,
    product.catalog_metadata_status AS source_product_catalog_status,
    product.extended_data AS source_product_extended_data,
    observation.sync_mode AS source_sync_mode,
    observation.source_sync_status,
    observation.source_sync_finished_at,
    observation.source_sync_failed_count,
    observation.source_run_artifact_hash,
    normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(observation.subtype_name) AS normalized_finish_key,
    binding.matches AS source_mapping_count,
    binding.matches AS card_print_mapping_count,
    binding.matches AS card_printing_mapping_count,
    binding.matches AS identity_domain_count,
    NULL::bigint AS source_mapping_id,
    target.source_mapping_meta,
    target.card_print_id,
    target.gv_id,
    target.card_rarity,
    target.identity_domain,
    target.card_printing_id,
    target.printing_gv_id,
    target.finish_key,
    NULL::uuid AS variant_assignment_id,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 'exact_child_finish'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS variant_assignment_status,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 'CROSS_TCG_EXACT_FINISH_V2'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS variant_assignment_version,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 1::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS variant_assignment_confidence,
    false AS has_printed_number_evidence,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 'governed_cross_tcg_exact_finish_v2'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS mapping_method,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 1::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS mapping_confidence,
        CASE
            WHEN binding.matches = 1 THEN 'exact_child_finish'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS derived_variant_assignment_status,
    false AS cosmos_finish_authority,
    NULL::uuid AS edition_assignment_id,
    NULL::uuid AS gym_edition_assignment_id,
    NULL::uuid AS edition_binding_id,
    NULL::text AS edition_assignment_sha256,
    NULL::text AS edition_assignment_version,
    NULL::jsonb AS edition_assignment_payload,
    false AS edition_assignment_required,
    false AS edition_assignment_current,
    NULL::text AS edition_source_sync_finished_at,
    NULL::text AS printed_identity_modifier,
    NULL::uuid AS mtg_printing_mapping_id,
    target.cross_tcg_source_mapping_id,
    target.cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id
   FROM observations observation
     LEFT JOIN tcgcsv_source_artifacts artifact ON artifact.id = observation.source_artifact_id
     LEFT JOIN tcgcsv_source_products product ON product.product_id = observation.product_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS matches,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(target_1.*)) -> 0
                    ELSE NULL::jsonb
                END AS exact_target
           FROM v_cross_tcg_market_targets_v2 target_1
          WHERE target_1.product_id = observation.product_id AND target_1.category_id = observation.category_id AND target_1.group_id = observation.group_id AND target_1.finish_key = normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(observation.subtype_name)) binding ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(binding.exact_target) target(product_id integer, category_id integer, group_id integer, card_print_id uuid, gv_id text, card_rarity text, identity_domain text, card_printing_id uuid, printing_gv_id text, finish_key text, cross_tcg_source_mapping_id bigint, cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id uuid, source_mapping_meta jsonb) ON true;

views.name: v_cross_tcg_market_targets_v2
views.definition:
WITH targets AS (
         SELECT product.product_id,
            product.category_id,
            product.group_id,
            card.id AS card_print_id,
            card.gv_id,
            card.rarity AS card_rarity,
            identity.identity_domain,
            printing.id AS card_printing_id,
            printing.printing_gv_id,
            printing.finish_key,
            mapping.id AS cross_tcg_source_mapping_id,
            NULL::uuid AS cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id,
            mapping.meta AS source_mapping_meta
           FROM external_mappings mapping
             JOIN card_prints card ON card.id = mapping.card_print_id
             JOIN card_print_identity identity ON identity.card_print_id = card.id AND identity.is_active AND identity.identity_domain = 'one_piece_eng_print'::text
             JOIN card_printings printing ON printing.card_print_id = card.id
             JOIN tcgcsv_source_products product ON product.product_id::text = mapping.external_id AND product.category_id = 68
             JOIN tcgcsv_source_groups source_group ON source_group.group_id = product.group_id AND source_group.category_id = 68
          WHERE mapping.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND mapping.active AND mapping.external_id ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'::text AND (mapping.meta ->> 'mapping_authority'::text) = 'exact_durable_source_product_with_official_number_name'::text AND (mapping.meta ->> 'promotion_plan_version'::text) = 'ONE_PIECE_COMPLETE_ENGLISH_NUMBERED_PARENT_PROMOTION_PLAN_V1'::text AND (mapping.meta ->> 'durable_staging_row_id'::text) ~* '^[a-f0-9]{8}-([a-f0-9]{4}-){3}[a-f0-9]{12}$'::text AND (mapping.meta ->> 'source_group_id'::text) = product.group_id::text AND card.identity_domain = 'one_piece_eng_print'::text AND card.variant_key = ('tcgplayer_product_'::text || product.product_id::text) AND (card.external_ids ->> 'tcgplayer'::text) = product.product_id::text AND printing.is_provisional = false AND (printing.finish_key = ANY (ARRAY['normal'::text, 'foil'::text])) AND printing.provenance_source = 'ONE_PIECE_EXACT_PRODUCT_PRINTING_REPAIR_20260919'::text AND printing.provenance_ref ~ '^raw_imports:-?[0-9]+[|]master-index:[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND product.source_active AND product.catalog_metadata_status = 'current'::text AND source_group.source_active AND source_group.catalog_metadata_status = 'current'::text AND 1 = (( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                        CASE
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof(product.extended_data) = 'array'::text THEN product.extended_data
                            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                        END) field(value)
                  WHERE lower(field.value ->> 'name'::text) = 'number'::text)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                        CASE
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof(product.extended_data) = 'array'::text THEN product.extended_data
                            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                        END) field(value)
                  WHERE lower(field.value ->> 'name'::text) = 'number'::text AND upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM field.value ->> 'value'::text)) = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM card.number)) AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM card.number)) > 0)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_mappings other
                  WHERE other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND other.active AND other.id <> mapping.id AND (other.external_id = mapping.external_id OR other.card_print_id = card.id))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM card_printings other
                  WHERE other.card_print_id = card.id AND other.finish_key = printing.finish_key AND other.is_provisional = false AND other.id <> printing.id)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_printing_mappings other
                  WHERE other.active AND other.card_printing_id = printing.id AND (other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND (other.external_id <> mapping.external_id OR normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) IS NOT NULL AND normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) <> printing.finish_key) OR other.source = 'tcgplayer_market'::text AND other.external_id <> ((mapping.external_id || ':'::text) || printing.finish_key)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_printing_mappings other
                  WHERE other.active AND other.card_printing_id <> printing.id AND (other.source = 'tcgplayer_market'::text AND other.external_id = ((product.product_id::text || ':'::text) || printing.finish_key) OR other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND other.external_id = product.product_id::text AND (normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) IS NULL OR normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) = printing.finish_key))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT product.product_id,
            product.category_id,
            product.group_id,
            card.id,
            card.gv_id,
            card.rarity,
            identity.identity_domain,
            printing.id,
            printing.printing_gv_id,
            printing.finish_key,
            NULL::bigint AS int8,
            mapping.id,
            mapping.meta
           FROM external_printing_mappings mapping
             JOIN card_printings printing ON printing.id = mapping.card_printing_id
             JOIN card_prints card ON card.id = printing.card_print_id
             JOIN card_print_identity identity ON identity.card_print_id = card.id AND identity.is_active AND identity.identity_domain = 'pokemon_jpn'::text
             JOIN tcgcsv_source_products product ON product.product_id::text = mapping.external_id AND product.category_id = 85
             JOIN tcgcsv_source_groups source_group ON source_group.group_id = product.group_id AND source_group.category_id = 85
          WHERE mapping.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND mapping.active AND mapping.external_id ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'::text AND card.identity_domain = 'pokemon_jpn'::text AND printing.is_provisional = false AND (printing.finish_key = ANY (ARRAY['normal'::text, 'holo'::text, 'reverse'::text, 'foil'::text])) AND normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(mapping.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) = printing.finish_key AND product.source_active AND product.catalog_metadata_status = 'current'::text AND source_group.source_active AND source_group.catalog_metadata_status = 'current'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_printing_mappings other
                  WHERE other.active AND other.id <> mapping.id AND other.card_printing_id = printing.id AND (other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND other.external_id <> mapping.external_id OR other.source = 'tcgplayer_market'::text AND other.external_id <> ((mapping.external_id || ':'::text) || printing.finish_key)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_printing_mappings other
                  WHERE other.active AND other.id <> mapping.id AND other.card_printing_id <> printing.id AND (other.source = 'tcgplayer_market'::text AND other.external_id = ((mapping.external_id || ':'::text) || printing.finish_key) OR other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND other.external_id = mapping.external_id AND (normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) IS NULL OR normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(other.meta ->> 'source_subtype'::text) = printing.finish_key)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM external_mappings other
                  WHERE other.source = 'tcgplayer'::text AND other.active AND (other.external_id = mapping.external_id AND other.card_print_id <> card.id OR other.card_print_id = card.id AND other.external_id <> mapping.external_id)))
        )
 SELECT product_id,
    category_id,
    group_id,
    card_print_id,
    gv_id,
    card_rarity,
    identity_domain,
    card_printing_id,
    printing_gv_id,
    finish_key,
    cross_tcg_source_mapping_id,
    cross_tcg_printing_mapping_id,
    source_mapping_meta
   FROM targets target
  WHERE 1 = (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM card_print_identity identity
          WHERE identity.card_print_id = target.card_print_id AND identity.is_active)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM card_printing_truth_reviews review
          WHERE review.card_printing_id = target.card_printing_id AND review.active AND (review.public_visibility = ANY (ARRAY['hidden_pending_review'::text, 'hidden_unsupported'::text]))));

subtype_function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_tcgplayer_market_subtype_v1(raw_subtype text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
  select case lower(btrim(coalesce(raw_subtype, '')))
    when 'normal' then 'normal'
    when 'holofoil' then 'holo'
    when 'reverse holofoil' then 'reverse'
    when 'foil' then 'foil'
    else null
  end;
$function$
